name: Time Piece
author: gdeyoung
description: Time Piece — Omarchy's clock with the date in the bar label (Sunday Oct 18 4:20 PM), a gear-opened settings view (city-search world clocks, date toggle, timer defaults), a start/stop countdown timer, and a self-running pomodoro (25/5 focus-break cycles, long break every 4th, desktop notification on each phase flip)
